name: standard-document-release-cycle
readings: identify one semantic token in the corpus judged unique and rich enough (a Leader-admitted framing, a term cluster, a PDK) that a standards-form document over it is now warranted
collect its real corpus sources: notes, glossary terms, work orders, running code, by exact path
compose the sources faithfully into an IEEE/RFC/arxiv-style structure: Scope, Normative References, Definitions, normative content, Conformance, each section citing the paths it came from
writings: seat one draft document under this node's own content/documents/specifications/ tree, marked DRAFT-FOR-LEADER-REVIEW
mint one LMT work order of class define tracking the draft, naming this node as the drafting owner
closure-rules: no draft is released externally (no github publish, no public URL) before a Leader disposition is recorded against it
every normative-content section names the real corpus path(s) it was composed from; a section with no cited path is refused
the composer never seats its own draft as accepted; acceptance is the Leader's or the Leader's delegate's, recorded separately from this cycle
